notes.title: The Pledge Banquet - Update 0.7.3.0
notes.content: [p]Greetings, innkeepers![/p][p][/p][p]Following last week's tutorial and quality of life improvements update, we now present the first chapter of Travellers Rest's storyline. [/p][p][/p][p]Alongside the new story content, comes two new maps and a great deal of new NPCs. Here are all the details![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1139980/Travellers_Rest/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]The beginning of your adventure[/h3][p]Once you've completed the tutorial and your tavern has reached reputation level 5, you'll receive a very special visitor to your tavern. We don't want to give too much away because we want you to discover it all for yourselves, but you'll meet many new characters that will be important in future chapters.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/47c35d27c80ee27b75503ad10fcd2b1e31778fe7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Two new maps[/h3][p]The path leading north from the city's central plaza is now open. Time to gussy up to visit the gardens at the entrance of the Fellowship's castle. There resides the official headquarters of the Fellowship of Tavern Keepers, as well as a certain office you'll have to visit by legal obligation...[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/ccaa5b9e740690bc10393e78a9960192527334ae.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Quality of life improvements[/h3][p]As you now, we split this update in two. If you haven't been playing over the past week, you'll discover these improvements:[/p][list][*][p]Visual aids for aging barrels and crops.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to the tutorial, streamlining it and adding visual aids.[/p][/*][*][p]All empty buckets in the player's inventory get filled at once at the well.[/p][/*][*][p]Gamepad users now a better way of splitting stacks.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/9962bb075b49a12a31c98b14b0d29905efcf257d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]What we are working on[/h3][p]As we let you know some time ago, we're now focusing on developing the game's main storyline. Upcoming updates will also expand it and open new areas of the map.[/p][p]We're aware players are hoping for faster updates. We've hired two new developers and we're working hard to bring new content to you as quickly as possible while retaining our high quality standards.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/fc5165b07687506987bb261114a8c9cc178b8295.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]An animal sanctuary for your desktop[/h3][p]Our friends at OverPowered Team are working on Cozy Sanctuary, a desktop game where you take care of adorable animals. There's a demo available on Steam, and if it seems like something you'd enjoy, it would help them a lot if you added it to your wishlist.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3574760/Cozy_Sanctuary/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]Changelog[/h3][list][*][p]First chapter of the storyline has been added. [/p][/*][*][p]Two new maps have been added: the castle's garden area and the castle's interior.[/p][/*][*][p]Many new NPCs have been added, including major characters such as members of the Fellowship.[/p][/*][*][p]Three new main quests have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]New music themes have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that could cause a softlock when talking to another character.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the housekeeper to get stuck while cleaning.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the colors that could be selected in the drink dispenser interface to more closely resemble the label colors.[/p][/*][*][p]USA West coast server has been added as an option for online play.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the tables to appear in disrepair when starting a new gaming skipping the tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed errors that occur with the new split item stack interface for gamepad when the chest or inventory to transfer items to is full.[/p][/*][*][p]The split item stack interface for gamepad can now also be used to split items between the action bar and the player inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Filling all buckets at the well now stacks them with existing filled buckets in the player's inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]The crop info pop-up now shows only shows the watered soil info for dead crops.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a visual bug that caused the active quest panel to show over the Construction Mode interface.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that could cause various characters and objects to appear incorrectly in an area outside the tavern.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed other minor bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]Translations have been updated.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Tutorial and Quality of Life Improvements - Update 0.7.2
notes.content: [p]Greetings, innkeepers![/p][p][/p][p]As we explained in our last announcement, this update will come out in two parts, this being the first: we've added some quality of life improvements in response to your feedback, and also made some changes to the tutorial to make it shorter and more interactive.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1139980/Travellers_Rest/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]Quality of Life Improvements[/h3][p]One of our most requested features has been a way to check on the state of crops more clearly. Now, when you hover your cursor over a crop you can see how many more days it needs to mature or yield harvest, and whether they need to be watered.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/9962bb075b49a12a31c98b14b0d29905efcf257d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You can now pin or unpin quests as you see fit, and gamepad players can now split item stacks within your inventory or between it and chests.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/e495b2dfec55df19c0acca15f2fcd1423800267b.png"][/img] [/p][p][/p][p]Now, when you fill buckets with water at the well, all the empty buckets in your inventory get filled at once instead of the action needing to be repeated for each one. And last but not least, we've improved the aging barrels' visuals: the color of the bar will match its aging rank, enabling you to see the progression of all the drinks in your cellar at a glance.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/e6466be61240656a9a424afb0f656e97c4be3624.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Changes in the tutorial[/h3][p]To ease new players into the game better, we've made some changes to the tutorial to make it shorter and clearer. For certain steps, arrows will appear to indicate to the player where they must go or what they should interact with next.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/6dcb9db13b127fd1183965f4bceef8ba1334779a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]It's been streamlined considerably, with many steps shortened or redesigned, such as with the player's first crafters and work areas.[/p][p][/p][p]Now, instead of built from scratch, in the tutorial the crafters will just need to be repaired (requiring only few materials). Once they're like new, the player can bring Mai some resources to repair the tavern completely and restore it to its former glory.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/76061edcfc89a1ec75c2a75f9c237f9eba662379.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]As you might expect, these changes will affect players who currently find themselves in the middle of the tutorial, and will have to start it over if they update to this new version before finishing it.[/p][p][/p][h3]First chapter of the story[/h3][p]The second part of the update will arrive next week, so you won't have long to wait to enjoy the first chapter of the game's storyline where you can challenge the Fellowship.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/7cd87ae81f7429ac9525d354216e951144cb6e06.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Change log[/h3][list][*][p]The tutorial has been streamlined and shortened. This will cause players currently in the middle of it to have to start it over..[/p][/*][*][p]More visual cues have been added to several steps of the tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p]Repairing the tavern can now be done outside of the tutorial as a separate quest.[/p][/*][*][p]A new interface has been added that allows players to view the state of their crops and fruit trees.[/p][/*][*][p]New colors have been added to the aging barrels' progress bars to indicate their aging rank at a glance.[/p][/*][*][p]Quests can now be pinned and unpinned, allowing the player to choose which to follow.[/p][/*][*][p]Gamepad users can now split stacks of items in their inventory or between it and chests as they wish.[/p][/*][*][p]Now, when filling buckets of water at the well, all empty buckets in the player's inventory get filled in one go.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor bugs have been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Translations have been updated.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: News about the next update
notes.content: [p]Greetings, innkepers![/p][p][/p][p]Since the "Pet Party" update, we've been working hard on the upcoming new content, including the [b]first chapter of the game's storyline[/b]. We wish to give you a sneak peek of what awaits you in the next update, as well as some more information that may be of interest to you![/p][p][/p][h3]Update with the first chapter of the story[/h3][p]The new update is practically done and we're just dotting the i's and crossing the t's at the moment, but since the team will be on holiday in August, we don't want to release it while we aren't around to address any unexpected issues that may arise.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/4d132f4dd39bc3903892ad99c939bb26f263ea34.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]For this reason, we expect to publish the update at the [b]beginning of September[/b]. When we know the exact date, we'll announce it on our socials.[/p][p][/p][h3]Changes in the tutorial[/h3][p]We've been paying attention to your feedback since we released the game's tutorial, and we'll be implementing some changes to [b]improve its pacing[/b] (and adding a few twists to keep it interesting).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/3ab5fcd19073980511666538be33859e54213332.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Since the update to the tutorial means that players who are in the middle of it will have to re-start it (this will not affect players who have already completed the tutorial), we'll release this [b]one week before the new content update[/b] so as few players as possible are affected.[/p][p][/p][p]Lastly, we'd like to introduce you to [b]Cozy Sanctuary[/b], a desktop idle game made by OverPowered Team in which you can take care of adorable animals at the bottom of your screen while you're doing other things. If you're curious, there's a demo available on Steam for you to try.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3625510/Cozy_Sanctuary_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Pet Party - Update 0.7.1.0
notes.content:
Greetings, innkeepers!

The new update of Travellers Rest has arrived, chock-full of new content. Let's start with a warm welcome to the new member of the family, for you can now adopt a dog as a companion in your adventures!

There's also a new building, two new characters and even a new crafter. Keep reading for all the details!

[previewyoutube=fRhOknIAwfQ;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1139980/Travellers_Rest/

[h3]Your new companion[/h3]
Whether you're stocking up in the city or exploring the great outdoors, your dog will follow you wherever you go. As well as give you company, it will also dig up new resources that will be of great value to you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/ccb9f2a9bdffcce705ea7261509926a4eee5374a.gif[/img]

[h3]A new shop in the city[/h3]
The Burrow is here! The animal rescue center has opened its doors to the right of Agatha's stall. Drop by and meet all its adorable inhabitants (though not all of them are available to adopt, of course).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/027228feb3669d6418966f434cfd04f23a344abc.gif[/img]

[h3]Two new characters to meet[/h3]
Nessy and Markus are the owners of the animal rescue center, and you can purchase all kinds of items and treats from them to make your pets the happiest in the realm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/8399cca6557a3e873db80c617cf353d71326c555.gif[/img]

[h3]A new system for your cat[/h3]
We've revamped and clarified your cat's affection system. Now you can view its needs and affection level directly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/69fdf0ecc81441fa0cbaffad80544992bf43392a.png[/img]

[h3]The artifacts table has arrived[/h3]
From now on, you'll be able to dig up new resources from holes, among them archaeological pieces with which you can craft a great deal of new decorations for your tavern at the artifacts table.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/6c7ab620b1e23672045b2ed0044bbd167286c493.png[/img]

[h3]New save system[/h3]
We've improved the game's save system, which will now automatically create a back-up copy that the system can use in case a saved game ever gets corrupted, keeping your progress safe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/bf53833acd0e45fe4a1f9021a56a9b8a64486424.gif[/img]


[h3]Live a new unique adventure with SEDAP![/h3]
Our friends at kopiforge have just released SEDAP!, a cooking adventure with co-op in which you explore the mysterious Khaya Island while cooking traditional South-East Asian recipes. If you already own Travellers Rest, you can get it at a very special price!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/54100/Delicious_Pack/

[h3]What's next?[/h3]
We're already working on the next update. In it you'll discover new pieces of the story of Travellers Rest, as you'll match wits in your first culinary duel against a master tavern keeper, and be able to access a ton of new content to make your taverns shine like never before. Stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/4fce1a56c0af2b907e7821e3732382dcc6688775.gif[/img]

[h3]Change Log[/h3]
[list]
[*] The animal rescue center has been added.
[*] Two new characters have been added.
[*] A new shop has been added in the animal rescue center.
[*] The cat's affection system has been changed.
[*] A new information panel for the cat can now be viewed.
[*] The cat's water bowl has been changed for a feeder that includes food as well as water.
[*] A new pet has been added: the dog.
[*] New quests have been added for the animal rescue center.
[*] The system for digging up items from holes has been changed, and new rewards can be obtained from them now.
[*] A new crafter has been added: the Artifacts Table.
[*] 40 new animal-themed items have been added.
[*] 31 new archaeology and geology themed items have been added.
[*] 5 new hairstyles have been added.
[*] Considerable improvements to the game's performance have been made, and will continue to be in future updates.
[*] New save system automatically creates a back-up copy of your save in your saved games folder.
[*] Various minor bugs have been fixed.
[*] A new language option has been added: Latin American Spanish.
[*] Translations have been updated.
[/list]

notes.title: Online multiplayer open beta now available!
notes.content:
Greetings, innkeepers!

After toiling away at it, we're proud to present the online multiplayer open beta. You can now share your adventures with up to three others, all playing remotely!

Keep in mind that bug-fixing will be ongoing during the beta process, so you may experience some errors as you play. With your help, we'll soon be able to launch the definitive version of the online mode, polished to perfection!

We also recommend [b]making a backup copy of your save files[/b] to make sure that you don't lose any progress and can get it back at any moment during the beta.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/e4ff634f926130d7ba96354a3fc9ecf55fd5f630.gif[/img]


[h3]Important: back up your game[/h3]

You can find your game saves at C:\Users\YOUR USER\AppData\LocalLow\Louqou\TravellersRest. Make a copy of your save files in a different folder for safekeeping so you can get your progress back if needed!


The Load Game menu also has the option to duplicate your save file.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/c3dec7c26d6c9a3b8616bddcba6d305b9a1ac31d.png[/img]

Once your game save is duplicated, you can play with no worries. We would greatly appreciate it if you notify us of any bugs you encounter. You can do so through our in-game bug report system, our Discord server, or our email bugs@isolatedgames.com.


If possible, attach the files "Player.log", "Player-prev.log" and the save file itself, which can all be found in the same folder (C:\Users\YOUR USER\AppData\LocalLow\Louqou\TravellersRest). This way, we'll have all the information we need to pinpoint the error!


[h3]How to access the beta[/h3]

To play the open beta, go to the Travellers Rest page in your game library.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/4e69c7b6fa4955e4d8ff8eb7e70be63e5b8fd34a.png[/img]

Once there, click on the cogwheel icon on the right and open the 'Properties' window.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/4d386089357f3f76d97eed8624949a98b0a933f1.png[/img]

Go to the fourth section, Betas, and in the Beta Participation dropdown select the one called "onlinebeta".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/f9feeaed24cffcb04fb1a8ab9df06aa09b80280c.png[/img]

Once the update has finished downloading you'll have access to the beta.

notes.title: Beekeeping and Irrigation - Update 0.6.6
notes.content:
Greetings, innkeepers!

The new update of Travellers Rest is here, bringing long-requested features: [b]irrigation systems[/b] and [b]apiaries[/b]. There are also [b]new decorations[/b] with which to personalize your tavern, [b]new recipes[/b], and [b]much more[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1139980/Travellers_Rest/

[previewyoutube=pMQCl9XiBDs;full]TRAILER EN YOUTUBE[/previewyoutube]

[h3]Irrigation System[/h3]
We know you’ve put your watering cans through their paces, so we wish for you to give them a break. The new irrigation systems are a fantastic way to optimize your crops and spend less time watering. Each one waters 8 squares, so distribute them wisely!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/04ee66226fed3afe361b271db341c10a1c8e4a86.png[/img]
 
[h3]Apiaries[/h3]
Thanks to the new bees you will now be able to obtain more honey than ever before, so to make the most of the occasion we’ve added new recipes that have honey as one of their ingredients. The bees also produce beeswax which you can use to craft candles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/ae25aeb2f50b4845e7655f6c94258a5b35df7d3f.png[/img]

[h3]New Decorations[/h3]
Bestow your tavern with an intellectual air with the bookshelves and more than 20 new available decorations, which include new windows and tablecloths.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/96195f2e600d11b3805b9be83b6ecfa09a8cbcc1.png[/img]

[h3]Other Additions and Improvements [/h3]
We’ve added two more hairstyles you can obtain from Wilson’s store. Also, after reading your feedback we’ve added a new alarm system you can use if you purchase the Cuckoo Clock from Agatha’s shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/7d8e065cb15c1cce5d183bb9be51075ee815c6b9.png[/img]

[h3]What we’re working on [/h3]
Most of the team is currently working on the online multiplayer mode, and we plan to release it in the first trimester of 2025. We appreciate your patience as we undertake all the hard work required to bring this feature to fruition.





[h3]Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*] The new irrigation system has been added, which will make it easier for you to take care of your crops.
[*] Apiaries have been added with which you can produce honey and wax.
[*] New Encyclopedia entries: an entry on Irrigation has been added to the Growing Crops section, and one on Apiaries added to the Livestock section.
[*] New honey-based recipes have been added.
[*] New decorations have been added to shops.
[*] New decoration blueprints have been added to shops.
[*] New hairstyles have been added to Wilson's shop.
[*] New wall item added: the cuckoo clock, with which you can set alarms.
[*] Players can now click on the date or time to swap between the two instantly. This way, you won't have to wait to see what day it is.
[*] New new language options have been added: Catalan and Portuguese from Portugal.
[*] Fixed several visual bugs in the user interfaces in local co-op mode.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused animal feeders not to work correctly.
[*] Fixed a bug that causes some items not to get filtered correctly in shops.
[*] Fixed several errors that could happen when felling trees.
[*] We have fixed a bug that caused the 'Mother Plant' perk to give free seeds when harvesting fruit trees. This perk only affects plants, not trees.
[*] Fixed several minor bugs.
[*] Text and translations have been updated.
[/list]

notes.title: City & Story Update - v0.6.5
notes.content:
Greetings, innkeepers!

The biggest Travellers Rest update (yet) is now available! This new update adds a new introduction to the game's story, a new tutorial, a new skill tree and a new area in the game's map: the city, a place filled with new characters and things to do.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1139980/Travellers_Rest/

In the following trailer, you can see the main new features of the update:

[previewyoutube=0hj0X84aMYA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Story introduction[/h3]
Immerse yourself in the history of Rilia and discover the backstory of Rygar, the first Tavern Keeper King, with a brand new narrated introduction. Uncover secrets and embark on your adventure as an innkeeper of the realm. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/74fdc9705256c78adebfd79d6ed67377417cd4e1.png[/img]

[h3]New tutorial[/h3]
The new tutorial will teach new players all the game's mechanics. And you won’t be alone! Mai, the boggart, will accompany you through the new tutorial and help you take your first steps. Listen to her advice, and soon you’ll hit the ground running!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/ab0adece3d025076c72af9218b9819657a449680.png[/img]

[h3]Visit the city[/h3]
The world of Travellers Rest grows further, giving you access to the city. There you’ll meet new people and shops, as well as three new businesses run by multifarious characters. Explore every corner to find the best products!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/8120014775b755537096d6a8a99cb703fd7c4d2d.png[/img]

[h3]New skill tree[/h3]
The skill tree has been revamped, with a much more streamlined progression system. Invest your points wisely and turn your character into the best innkeeper in the kingdom!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/ae457bc1f53bac5fffe7d56653621d1e6ea4f7aa.png[/img]

[h3]The postbox has changed[/h3]
With the city opening its gates, the postbox has changed its function. From now on, you'll be able to receive letters from some characters, and new features will be added in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/8834e8eb7efccd0b92d78bc1c0cec831971b3a37.png[/img]

notes.title: Fishing - Update 0.6.4
notes.content:
Greetings, innkeepers!

The new Travellers Rest update is now available! This new update adds the fishing system, new fish dishes to cook, a lot of new decorations, many fish species to collect, new characters and unlocks a new area of the map.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1139980/Travellers_Rest/

[previewyoutube=Opt8OZg8byM;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Opt8OZg8byM[/previewyoutube]


[h3]New fishing system[/h3]
With the new fishing system you'll be able to catch more than 30 different species. Use the fish you catch to prepare delicious dishes, or decorate the walls of your tavern with your best catches. All the fish you catch will be registered in your Collection, where you'll be able to read descriptions for each type of fish and check your records.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/7fb573c418dc07dc6f5f6b28144e46d816a0df45.png[/img]


[h3]New recipes[/h3]
This update also adds over 30 new fish-centric recipes so you can make delicious dishes with your catches!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/9ae71d6fc6e41ed792c2f1a8041288ed7ae71ed0.png[/img]


[h3]New decorations[/h3]
Any fish you catch can be used to decorate the walls of your tavern, but we've also added over 20 brand new marine-themed decorations. These items can be purchased from Wilson, one of the new characters in this update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/0a7adbc6ee724ccdbf06d06e49c3be62b8a188ef.png[/img]


[h3]New area and new characters[/h3]
Now, walking southwards from the farm, you can access a new area: the beach. At the beach you'll be able to fish for saltwater fish, set traps in the water and collect new resources for your tavern. In addition, at the beach you'll also find two new characters: Hikari, who will be your mentor in the art of fishing, and Wilson, a castaway who can turn any piece of junk into art.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/a81e08a7443e7920ae9c785a64c0764a23a073d4.png[/img]


[h3]Other additions and improvements[/h3]
This update contains many small additions and improvements. For example, we've also added a Collections window where you can view all the fish you have caught. In later updates, we'll add other types of items you can collect and view there. We've also added a handy duplicate savegame option that will allow you to have multiple saves of the same game. We've also fixed various bugs and improved performance.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/7f17851dfa4aab7a13ad7bcc76537d6e6c425690.png[/img]




[h3]Change log[/h3]
[list]
[*]The fishing system has been added.
[*]Two types of rods have been added, in future updates you'll be able to obtain better rods.
[*]Added 5 types of bait for the rod.

[*]A Collections tab has been added to the inventory menu. In it you can see the fish that have been caught so far.

[*]A new area has been added: the beach.

[*]The number of recipe fragments awarded per level has been increased.

notes.title: Recipes and Farming - Update 0.6.3
notes.content:
Hello, innkeepers!

The new update for Travellers is now available! It includes a revamp of the crop-growing system, a new way to unlock recipes, weather phenomena and a great deal of new content.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1139980/Travellers_Rest/


[h3]New crop system[/h3]
Now crops have specific seasons in which they can be planted. In addition, they need to be watered every 3 days for them to grow. The amount of time each crop takes to grow varies.
Fruit trees no longer need to be planted in tilled soil, don't require watering and they never die, although they only bear fruit during certain seasons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/59aa780f968ebecdd064e165976cbf9f64e9de0e.png[/img]


[h3]Recipe Fragments[/h3]
This update introduces recipe fragments. These fragments are obtained as your reputation levels up. They can be exchanged for new recipes in the mysterious temple north of the tavern.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/0c033c020cded0297a290274c68f3d19fccb9dcb.png[/img]


[h3]Weather Phenomena[/h3]
We have added weather phenomena. Depending on the season, there will be different chances of rain, thunderstorms, snow or wind. The weather will affect animals and crops. For example, if it rains, your crops will be watered. We have also added a toggle in the Options menu to disable lightning flashes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/bead493b0514d9e4d8f10822ca3bfcdc14470337.gif[/img]


[h3]Autosave[/h3]
From this update, when the player goes to sleep, the game will automatically be saved. It will no longer be necessary to select the game to overwrite the save.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/42299eb1e6480d78d5fe91b8d58905880e11d29b.gif[/img]


[h3]New Content[/h3]
This update adds over 100 new recipes, 32 new crops and 2 new areas. We are still working on creating new areas and characters, which will be added in upcoming updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/260cffa49fbe66b838c5490a7accdb89b43648dc.gif[/img]


[h2]Other News[/h2]
Starting from January 21st, the price of Travellers Rest will be slightly increased. Over the course of Early Access, the game has leaped forwards in quality and content, which has meant more new team members and therefore, more production costs.

In any case, we wanted to let you know ahead of time so that any player who has been thinking about buying Travellers Rest can get it before the price increase takes place.



[h3]Change log[/h3]
[list]
[*]The crop-growing system has been re-vamped.
[*]32 new crops have been added.
[*]Now all crops are available from the start and do not require any unlocking.
[*]Tilled soil must now be watered before planting a crop.
[*]Tilled soil should be watered every 3 days so that the plants continue to grow.
[*]Rains and storms water the tilled soil for one day.
[*]Fruit trees can now be planted outside of tilled soil.
[*]Fruit trees do not need to be watered anymore.
[*]Now crops and fruit trees have specific seasons of the year in which they bear fruit.
[*]Crops die at the start of a season that is unsuitable for them.
[*]Fruit trees never die and bear fruit during their harvest season.
[*]Crops and fruit trees now have a small chance of yielding extra output during one of their harvesting seasons.
[*]The time it takes crops and fruit trees to grow varies depending on the type of crop or tree.
[*]Now, the XP improvement "Farming" increases the price obtained from fruits and vegetables in dishes instead of increasing the harvest output.
[*]The "Cooking" and "Harvest" tabs have been removed from the Technologies window.
[*]Now the fruits that appear available for purchase vary according to the season of the year.
[*]Because fruit trees now cannot die, only one fruit tree bud will be available in stores per week.
[*]Because fruit trees now cannot die, the trees that players have planted so far have been removed and replaced by the harvest that those trees would give.
[*]Now aromatic herbs, berries, blackberries and spices are not  grown, but can be found all around the map, growing in the wild.
[*]We have added different types of mushrooms, which can be found around the map, growing in the wild.
[*]We have improved the system for selecting squares when digging, tilling or watering. Now it should be easier to perform these actions.
[*]The maximum reputation level has been increased to 50.
[*]The amount of experience needed to level up in the first reputation levels has been reduced.
[*]Now, for each reputation level, 10 recipe fragments are received. Players with old games will receive the recipe fragments equivalent to their current reputation level.
[*]The reputation level needed to reach the tavern's maximum capacity has been increased.
[*]It is now possible to change the color of storage chests.
[*]A new "shop" with 100 recipes has been added, where recipe fragments can be exchanged for recipes.
[*]Two new crafters have been added: the Preserves table and the press.
[*]Pickled dishes must now be pickled in the aging rack.
[*]Weather effects have been added: sunny, slightly cloudy, cloudy, wind, rain and thunderstorms.
[*]We have added an option to disable the flashes of light that lightning causes. Players with epilepsy should disable this option.
[*]We have added two new areas accessible from the north of the tavern.
[*]The game is now automatically saved when you go to sleep. It is no longer possible to save manually.
[*]We have improved the sound system. Now, the amount of reverb depends on the location.
[*]Improved the outdoor ambience sound when the player is indoors.
[*]A new music theme has been added.
[*]Two new languages have been added to the game: Hungarian and Indonesian.
[/list]

notes.title: Drinks & Staff Update - v0.6.1
notes.content:
Greetings, innkeepers!

The new Travellers Rest update is now available! With this update we've changed some of the tavern's mechanics, added a new employee system, added seasonal visual changes, and a few other things.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1139980/Travellers_Rest/


[h3]New system for serving drinks[/h3]
Customers can now order drinks from their table. To serve them, the player and employees now have a tray which can carry up to 5 drinks. And now, in addition to the taps at the bar, beverages can also be stored in serving barrels that can be placed against the wall behind the bar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/499c4a8f944ad4fe7836373eacacebdba12bb158.png[/img]


[h3]New employee system[/h3]
We've changed the employee system. Now there's a list of candidates that gets refreshed on Mondays and Thursdays. Each candidate will have a different set of skills, so each one is different from the others. Also, employees can now level up and improve their skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/4bda4481e070f01173037732ba39a61f5507a41a.png[/img]


[h3]New employee: the Bouncer[/h3]
With the new system, the watchman is added. He will deal with rowdy customers, and eject them from the premises if necessary. Bouncers also make sure other employees don't take longer breaks than they should.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/d361a8be69507b4c7e4ef624dc9c9698e5cd78f5.png[/img]


[h3]Seasons[/h3]
All four seasons have been added to the game. Watch how everything changes depending on which season you are in! Although these are only visual changes for now, we'll soon implement new mechanics around this system and the weather.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/d8d38fa732ed5e842ba02d272de8a6dce78fe7c7.png[/img]


[h3]New guest room system[/h3]
In this update, some modifications have been made to the the guest room system. Guests can now spend more than one night at your inn. Also, when the tavern is open, they'll order food and drinks from their rooms. We've also created a new reception desk where guests can check-in without taking up space at the bar. The housekeeper will now be able to assign rooms to guests, and serve room service orders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/12130d844d17e1e8a03ebd16883f7892728e5ab9.png[/img]


[h3]New beverage aging system[/h3]
Beverages can now be aged in the new aging barrels. Unlike in the previous system, beverages can have 5 different levels of aging, and level up the longer they are stored in these new barrels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/4867df4f6924cd930335414e89515bc3607d9129.png[/img]


[h2]Other News[/h2]

[h3]Tokyo Game Show[/h3]
Travellers Rest will be at Tokyo Game Show from the 21st to the 24th of September!

We invite you come visit our stand in Hall 9, 09-E69, at the Makuhari Messe International Exhibition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/5dba8052adebe54c24fdbb4159a9bc69d0b181c6.jpg[/img]


[h3]Into the Necrovale[/h3]
A good friend of ours, Casey Clyde, will soon release [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1717090/Into_the_Necrovale/]Into the Necrovale[/url], a pixel art Action RPG made with a lot of dedication and love. 

We'd really appreciate if you could support the project by [b]adding it to your wishlist[/b]. Thank you very much!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1717090/Into_the_Necrovale/



[h3]Change log[/h3]
[list]
[*]We have added seasonal changes. At the moment, they are only visual.
[*]Now, in addition to the bar taps, you can have 4 serving kegs behind the bar.
[*]Now, only carbonated drinks can stored in the bar taps.
[*]Now, the player has a tra which can carry up to 5 drinks.
[*]Customers can now order drinks from their tables.
[*]Serving barrels can now be refilled with water using a water bucket.
[*]Now, when there is no other beverage available, customers will order water.
[*]We've added colors to the taps and serving barrels to easily identify the beverages customers ordered.
[*]Guests can now stay more than one night in the rooms.
[*]Guests will now leave the rooms in the morning and return after a few hours so that their room can be cleaned.
[*]Cleaning rooms during a guest's stay gives extra reputation.
[*]Now, it isn't possible to assign a guest a dirty room.
[*]Guests now have criteria for size and comfort. If their conditions aren't met, they'll pay less per night.
[*]While the tavern is open, guests staying in rooms can order food or drinks.
[*]There are now different employee candidates available for hire, the list is updated on Mondays and Thursdays.
[*]Now each employee has different skills, which can be leveled up as they work.

[*]Now, you can decide which tasks each employee shall perform.
[*]Now, each employee's salary depends on their skill level and the selected tasks they perform.
[*]Now, employees occasionally leave the tavern to take a break.
[*]Now, the housekeeper also assigns rooms to guests automatically, serves room service orders, replaces burned out candles, and lights the fireplace.

[*]Contrast of stains on tables has been increased to make them more visible.

notes.title: Farm Animals Update - v0.6
notes.content:
Hello, innkeepers!

The farm animals update has arrived to Travellers Rest. Now, you’ll have a new area available, with new NPCs and shops with new products. Thanks to the new buildings, you’ll be able to take care of your own animals to obtain different ingredients to use in your recipes.

[previewyoutube=S6e08z1fupM;full][/previewyoutube]

These are some of the new update’s features:

[h3]Harvest Hill Farm and new shops[/h3]
Harvest Hill Farm is now open! Meet its new owners and discover its products: animals, buildings, ingredients... Anything is possible if you have enough gold in your bag!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/56bfd49837536ea94fee6f7b73c18f625e2d15b5.png[/img]

[h3]New NPCs and event system[/h3]
Buzz and the other members of his family have unique routines and events - talk to them or watch them interact with each other to get to know them better!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/681796d345d1bfb1d3d2f06b34feb64e52c0fa55.png[/img]

[h3]Buildings and improvements[/h3]
You will now be able to construct new buildings on your land that will allow you to raise and take care of your new animals. Upgrading your buildings to the maximum will allow you to keep more animals and make it much easier to take care of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/f666038f02246e2a093801ee9a690b257c1b48a4.png[/img]

[h3]Animal husbandry[/h3]
With the new buildings, you’ll be able to keep animals on your land and obtain resources from them. Cows, chickens, sheep, pigs... Each one has different characteristics and will give you different ingredients to make a variety of dishes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/af49ad5fe9a73c3c55682f567d5775fe5174d7c5.png[/img]

[h3]New recipes, ingredients, and new crafting system[/h3].
New ingredients and recipes have been added to the game that will allow you to earn more money from your dishes. These new recipes change the crafting system so that the ingredient combinations make more sense and the possible variations have a greater impact on the final price.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/ea82a24f6e5649e9c5725e8f4097c9deb7e97431.png[/img]



[h3]Change log[/h3]
[list]
[*] We have increased the maximum reputation level to level 25.
[*] We have added 7 new items that you can get as a reward for leveling up your reputation.
[*] The map of the farm’s exterior has been changed.
[*] We’ve added a new map: inside Harvest Hill Farm.
[*] We’ve added the new systems for building and modification of buildings.
[*] We’ve added a new store (Holly).
[*] The new animal husbandry system has been created.
[*] We’ve added a new store to buy farm animals.
[*] We’ve added 4 farm animals: cow, pig, sheep and chicken.
[*] We’ve added two new crops: lettuce and peppers.
[*] We’ve modified some of the technologies.
[*] Some talent bonuses have been re-balanced.
[*] We’ve created a new crafting system for the new recipes.
[*] We’ve added 25 new recipes.
[*] We’ve added new ingredients.
[*] The prices of some old recipes have been modified.
[*] We’ve added descriptions to many objects that did not have them.
[*] Two new crafting tables have been added: the food prep table and the forage table.
[*] The Cheesery’s appearance has been modified.
[*] The oven’s appearance has been modified.
[*] We’ve created new icons to show the modifiers and ingredients of the recipes.
[*] We've added 3 new NPCs: Holly, Violet and Arthur.
[*] We’ve created a system of routines for the NPCs.
[*] Some events have been added for the farm NPCs.
[*] We’ve balanced the price of ingredients and seeds.
[*] CPU performance has been optimized.
[*] Pathfinding has been improved.
[*] Now, in 4k resolution or higher, you can choose the scaling of the interface.
[*] Marmalade is now an ingredient and can no longer be sold as a dish.
[*] Mozzarella can no longer be aged.

notes.title: Local Co-op Update - v0.5.5
notes.content:
Hello Innkeepers!

A new update for Travellers Rest is here! In this update we have rebuilt the interface navigation system to fix the problems in the local co-op mode. We have also added a new area with new characters.

[h3]Local Co-op fixes[/h3]
Now, the local cooperative mode can be played without pauses − players do not have to wait for the other player to finish using a menu to continue playing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/9eae2a160edfcb783ba5e9c3bef6806820181f4e.png[/img]

In addition, players now have an individual inventory and action bar, so will no longer have to share inventory space.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/6a715457545e6c1fd088168dc70c64ce2269a4bf.png[/img]


When the second player leaves the game, the items in the second player's inventory are stored in the second player's special chest. Player 1 will be able to continue playing in single player mode and get back the items that the second player had in the chest whenever he/she wants. If the items are still there, when the second player enters the game, the items will automatically be placed in his/her inventory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/714f0c33cd15f1027d5acb01a230a6df8b473f60.png[/img]


[h3]New Map Zone[/h3]
This update also unlocks a new area that can be found by following the river south of the tavern. In this new zone, you will find a family moving into the farm in the area, and they will soon be supplying valuable resources for your business!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/4f8c3a6d534e13d7c4385e747d87f3f30429ac39.png[/img]

You will also meet Bob, a friendly golem who will sell you all kinds of objects he finds in the mountains and the forest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/792b08acce194c6e7b6f0973ea8df1f2745d782c.png[/img]

[h3]What's next?[/h3]
In the next update, among other surprises, we expect to introduce farm animals. The available land of your tavern will increase, and you will be able to raise farm animals that will provide valuable resources to the tavern.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/7f3da99b64adbedc258a8f72030af7882092a414.png[/img]

[h3]Change Log[/h3]
[list]
[*] We have added a new map area south of the tavern.
[*] We have added two new NPCs.
[*] We have added two new scrap objects that can be melted in the Smelter to obtain ingots.
[*] We have created duplicates of most windows so that they can be opened at the same time in local cooperative mode.
[*] We have changed the format of many windows to fit in the split-screen format.
[*] We have created a new UI navigation system that supports two simultaneous players.
[*] Now, in local co-op mode, the game no longer pauses if a player accesses a menu.
[*] The second player now has an individual inventory and action bar.
[*] Due to screen space limitations, the players' action bars now have only 8 slots in co-op mode. 
[*] When the co-op mode is started, the leftover items from the first player's action bar are sent to the inventory or, if they don't fit, to the delivery chest.
[*] Added the item "Second player's chest" which is given to the second player when he joins the game and there is no other chest like it.
[*] The second player's inventory is now saved in the second player's chest when the second player leaves the game.
[/list]

notes.title: World & Birds Update - v0.5.2.0
notes.content:
Hello Innkeepers!

We've just released a new major update for Travellers Rest!

This new update adds parrots, a world expansion, the first NPC, achievements, a new UI and more!


[h2]World Expansion[/h2]
The new update adds two new beautiful maps, a river area south of the tavern, and a deep forest area worth visiting at night. We've also expanded the outside area of the tavern and made it prettier. To create these new maps, we have completely redone the old tiles.

Crowly will sell you eggs from which birds will hatch. You'll be able to put a bird in your dinning room, and it will make comments about your customers and your tavern, sometimes these comments will be good, sometimes bad. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/905b28bea8b7c61f72ce36bb12adf9c5078a75ff.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/e424facbf000b461e8fca082b9097b9580911b6f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/dfa9bce8d872d1c7ea159a0b2b182bab7f42d2b4.gif[/img]

The art team has been working for months on the next update, in two months we will release the update that will replace the old characters by the new models and animations. This update will give a great step up in quality to the game and will allow us to finally develop new mechanics, NPCs and more world.

notes.title: Update 0.4.4 - New Exterior
notes.content:
Hello innkeepers!

We have just released a new update of Travellers Rest!

This latest version has many new features. We have updated the tavern's exterior artwork, expanded the outdoor area, improved item crafting and added new mechanics.

[h3]New Exterior Artwork[/h3]
We have remade the outside artwork. Now, the resolution and style of the outdoor sprites are the same as those inside the tavern. The breeze sways the trees and grass, and fireflies show up at night.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/8990f83d3083d8f821f52db0c2a7063a6fc5be80.png[/img]


[h3]Expanded and Improved Exterior[/h3]
We have increased the size of the area outside the tavern. In addition, we have removed the crop field at the north of the tavern, now you can plant crops anywhere on the map! For the time being, the outside of the tavern will be a sandbox to test new mechanics and for example, in the final version, the metal seams will not be as close to the tavern as they are now. As we expand the world, we will relocate the resources.


[h3]Rising Nature[/h3]
Now the trees and grass will reproduce. For example, in an area where there are trees of one type, more trees of the same kind will appear as the days go by. If you do not cut the grass, it will also spread over your land.


[h3]New Mechanics[/h3]
We have added a multitude of mechanics related to obtaining materials. Felling trees, mining seams, cutting tall grass...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/09df1c5d8ab68c0abe92fa9e271b2821461ac2dc.gif[/img]


[h3]New Crafters[/h3]
We have added three outdoor crafters with a new mechanic: the work zones. When you create a sawmill, it creates a work zone around it. Inside the sawmill's work zone, you can place objects dedicated to woodworking that can give bonuses to some recipes or allow the creation of new objects. You can expand the work zone, adding more sawmills near the first one. The three new crafters are the sawmill, the foundry and the stone workshop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/3ec3473d4c069ba81decbbe6e7322db151a3f413.gif[/img]


[h3]Crafting Revision[/h3]
We have adjusted several crafting elements that were not working. A new talent tree has been created in the construction section, a multitude of crafting recipes and new resources have been added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/fde58939392f908747a9b0926703b34f66901df8.png[/img]


[h3]Tavern Capacity and Satisfaction[/h3]
From now on, the capacity of the tavern is not regulated by the number of tables, but by the reputation level of the tavern. We have also added a satisfaction meter. If customer satisfaction is high, more customers will come to the tavern, and they will pay more money for the services. To increase satisfaction, keep the tavern clean, serve customers faster, and kick out annoying customers quickly.


[h3]Change Log[/h3]
[list]
[*]All exterior artwork has been redrawn.
[*]The exterior terrain of the Tavern has been expanded.
[*]The field area north of the Tavern has been removed.
[*]Crops and objects that were in the northern farm have been moved to the south of the tavern.
[*]Work zone system has been added.
[*]3 work zones have been added: Smelting, Sawmill and Stone Workshop.
[*]We have added items that give crafting bonuses to the work areas.
[*]8 new crafters have been added.
[*]New decorative items have been added.
[*]New crafting recipes have been added.
[*]3 new tools have been added: hoe, pickaxe and axe.
[*]You can now cut trees with the axe.
[*]You can now mine seams and rocks with the pickaxe.
[*]Now you can cut tall grass with the sickle.
[*]Now you can till the field with the hoe.
[*]Now the forest, tall grass and lawns expand as the days go by.
[*]Now the grass can be removed or replanted with the shovel.
[*]The sickle can now harvest several crops at once.
[*]The recipe list now shows the items sorted by type instead of showing them sorted by crafter.
[*]We have added a new tab in the general panel that shows basic tavern stats.
[*]A customer satisfaction meter has been added. Satisfaction is obtained by giving fast and good service to customers.
[*]Now the tavern capacity is calculated by reputation level instead of number of seats.
[*]Satisfaction can increase or decrease the maximum capacity and selling prices.
[*]The price of workers has been increased by 50%.
[*]Chests are now only accessible to crafters who are in the same area or room.
[*]The capacity of small chests has been reduced.
[*]Dropped items of the same type now stack together if they are close enough.
[*]Many errors have been fixed.
[/list]


[h3]What's Next[/h3]
We are currently working on the animation of the new characters. We are taking a little longer than expected as the characters may have quite a few variations of clothing. In the next updates we will start revising food recipes, and we will continue replacing the remaining old artwork with new artwork (icons, crops, dishes...).


[h3]New Gladiators Tavern Bundle![/h3]
We have made an agreement with GrabTheGames Publishing to create a bundle of Travellers Rest and their new game, Gladiator Guild Manager. This way, those of you who already own Travellers Rest will get an additional discount if you buy Gladiator Guild Manager using this Bundle, or if you don't own either game you can buy both at a reduced price!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23145/Gladiators_Tavern_Bundle/

Hello Tavern Keepers!

We wanted to take a moment to give you the heads-up on what’s been going on behind the scenes.
We are still a few weeks away from launching the update, but everything looks quite promising indeed.

One of the game’s most requested features, gamepad support, is almost wrapped up, and we are steadily advancing towards a very stable situation wherein you can play both with mouse and keyboard or with a gamepad without having to sacrifice anything. We’re building it from the ground up and with that comes a new and fancy UI which we’re sure many of you will love!

We’re also keeping our art team busy, they are currently in the process of swapping over much of the original art of the interior of the tavern to a higher quality shift, with their work expected to be done In time for when gamepad support wraps up.

After this update our art team will change the player characters and NPC's, as well as the tavern exterior.

notes.title: Update 0.3.4.0 - New Development Studio
notes.content:
Greetings, Tavern Keeps!

There is a new update for you, but also there is also some important news that we want to share with you. 

Many fans may not know that so far Travellers Rest has been created by a single developer and artist - Louqou. During this time the game has received an amazing response and grown a dedicated fan base and we all thank you so much for the support. Louqou, however, has realized that being a solo developer will not allow him to develop the game at a pace and quality you all deserve. Wanting what's best for the game and its fans Louqou has decided to pass future development onto another development studio. He apologizes for the delays in development this has caused. However, this big change has allowed us to redefine the scope of the game, such as including plans for new animations, art style, character models, and even maybe the highly requested feature - multiplayer in the future! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/3391753c59863b3bfb1dc61f54e4d35634fc7a76.gif[/img]
[h3]New developer[/h3]
Louqou decided to entrust us, Isolated Games, with the development of Travellers Rest. Alex, who was already working with him, will continue alongside us doing the great job he has been doing with Louqou helping us to improve the game. 

Isolated Games is a little indie studio from Barcelona, we are currently developing Between the Stars, a space action RPG game, and we are looking forward to working on Travellers Rest and taking it to another level. In order to develop it properly, we hired new staff to form a development group that will be dedicated exclusively to Travellers Rest. In the past, Louqou did all the art and programming of the game by himself, and now with the incorporation of specialists from different areas, we expect to significantly improve the quality of the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/71a41d0140d3cbbbe56de29f5fe0b32e16a7c5cc.gif[/img]
We have been working on it for a month and this will be our first update. We really love working on Travelers Rest to improve it, and we have been reading all the feedback that the community has left on the forums and Discord for a while to understand what is more adequate for the game according to the community.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/dc121e29bc1064ae3f905f1745913818f6136f88.gif[/img]
We've negotiated with GOG com and the game is now available there DRM free! Also, everyone who has Travellers Rest now has a discount available for Between the Stars in the Isolated Games Bundle.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/20465/

[h3]What will come[/h3]
We have a lot of plans for Travellers Rest.
[list]
[*]We'll improve the artistic style of the game. We are currently re-drawing all the assets with a higher pixel density in order to have much more detail. No more ladies that seem like men!

[*]We'll improve all the animations of the game. The new animations will look beautiful and smooth.

[*]Gamepad support! We're currently working on it and it will be ready soon!

[*]A new balanced crafting and farming system. New ways to get resources: fishing, cutting down trees, mining rocks...

[*]New construction system. Expand the tavern your way, add new dining rooms or kitchens.

[*]A bigger world! Every one loves to be focused in their taverns, but we would like to add the option to explore the world and get to know new characters.

[*]Multiplayer. It would be great to work in your tavern with friends, wouldn't it?
[/list]

To give you an idea of the new artistic style that Travelers Rest will have, we'll leave you with a small sample of the art tests that we are doing. Do not hesitate to leave your opinion in the comments below, we would like to know what you think about the new changes!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/5dd797572a892f836aa0e5e858130c04a49fa318.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/ae9efeffae0d5de82d17e1a74234e12247d5b6ab.gif[/img]

notes.title: Bigger Tavern Update - v0.3.3.0
notes.content:
Greetings, Tavern Keeps! 

First of all we wanted to briefly touch base with you about why we've taken two months to get this update out. During December, there was a complication when a team member caught covid and spent the better part of a month very ill. This severely hampered production and development of the game up until January when he was able to get back to work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/c5914014932ee240bef834e6d6baa7a779f6eed8.png[/img]

There are a number of new exciting features in this update. You will now be able to access the Wardrobe and change your clothing and accessories. 

You will also be able to upgrade the Tavern size in this update, which has been a hugely sought after feature! You'll also be able to auto-hire people to work on your Tavern consistently now. There's also a new staff member you can hire, the Housekeeper, who cleans your rented rooms. Last but not least we've taken care of a few nasty bugs!

Expect more consistant updates from here on in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/5389205ac6d0576757da1694d70e8d1d742eb876.png[/img]

[h3]v0.3.3.0 Change Log[/h3]
[list]
[*]You can now auto-hire staff.
[*]You can now upgrade the tavern floor to be larger.
[*]There is a new staff member available. The House Keeper. This staff member cleans your rooms for you every morning.
[*]There is now a button available to match your beard and hair color.
[*]There is now a wardrobe available to change your clothes and accesories.

[*]We've fixed a bug where saves are incorrectly ordered when restored through Steam Cloud.
[*]Now the player can exit locked customer rooms.
[*]Now if there is no translation detected in a line of text it will appear in English.
[*]We've fixed a bug in the magic broom that caused it to become stuck.
[/list]

notes.title: Holiday 2020 Developer Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/c968167911e5828e7b2470518e2b394c444a1818.gif[/img]

Greetings, Tavern Keeps! 

Today we want to update everyone on the current state of development, and where we’re headed with the game. We put out our first roadmap several months ago, and for the most part, have been able to stay on pace with that as it was shown. However, as we are now entering the holiday season, and the team begins to plan spending time (safely!) with family, we want to avoid rushing out features or content in a state that doesn’t hold up to our quality standards. 

For this reason, we have decided to hold off on the November update, and to focus on assembling the second roadmap, along with a more robust update after the holidays. The feedback and input from the community is a source of fantastic motivation for us, and has given us plenty to look over while we choose our next features. 

We wish everyone a safe, happy, and healthy holiday season! We urge everyone to take particular care this year as we all try to navigate the difficulties of the pandemic and what it means for our holiday traditions. We’re looking forward to 2021, and everything the new year will bring for Travellers Rest!

notes.title: October Roadmap, Halloween, and Crossroads Inn!
notes.content:
Greetings Tavern Keeps,

It’s that time again! Today we roll out the features for our October Roadmap Update. We have quite a bit here to unpack, so brace yourselves!  Gone are the days when your crafting room was so small you had, nowhere to put your stations. This update brings the expanded crafting room, which will allow you more space and freedom to set up your crafting the way you like. The extra room can be unlocked through upgrades.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/429de277f0ae948084dcd286907c90bf3423d84f.png[/img]

We also have the distillery ready to go, expanding again the choices for the types of drinks you’ll be able to serve. You can now offer various spirits and liqueurs in addition to all of your wines, beers, and other drinks. Along with these features come further quality of life improvements, and bug fixes as well. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/d12dbeceb5f8cd45823db3970610e419f9091f50.png[/img]

For those who may be worried that we’ve forgotten the Halloween update items, not to worry. The spooky season goodies will be rolling out next week in an update all their own. This allows us to align the content with an upcoming promotion for the game. Stay tuned for more on that! 

Here are the notes for this month’s Roadmap Update:

New stuff:
[list]
[*] Distilling: Create various spirits and liqueurs to sell in your tavern
[*] Expanded crafting room, unlocked through upgrades
[*] Crafting stations automatically pull ingredients from chests
[*] Access all crafting room chests from the recipe modifier menu
[*] Recipe Book: Browse and search through all available recipes
[*] Sort your chests and inventory by name or by item type
[*] Recipe search bar on crafting stations
[*] Brew cider!
[*] You can now place items in the farming area
[*] 
[/list]
Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Sprint bar now regenerates while walking
[*] Sliders on the color picker are now fixed
[*] Orders now require a full keg to complete
[*] Fixed issues with tavern floor worker not cleaning some tables
[*] Coaster should now place properly on table edges
[*] Increased hit box on logs and sticks found outside
[*] Items placed on the player’s bed will now save correctly
[*] Fruit is now a valid modifier for sausages
[/list]

What? You thought we were done? Not a chance! We are thrilled to announce that our friends at Klabater have agreed to bundle their game, Crossroads Inn, with Travellers Rest! This means that owners of either game have the option to receive a 10% discount on the purchase of the other title. Here is a little about the game: 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/867290/Crossroads_Inn/]Crossroads Inn[/url] is a real time management sim set in an original fantasy world of Delcrys. Build and manage your tavern, make visiting adventurers happy, and make your services famous all over the land.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/497d1be7b8c37ff5fc5273dbcfade66d3b9c2d1c.jpg[/img]

Why manage one tavern when you can manage two? Crazy! 

We have yet more to come in the month of October, so keep your eye on our social channels and [url=https://discord.gg/vczxm7]Discord[/url]  for more news! As always, we’re available on the Discord to chat, or listen to suggestions and feedback. If you run into any bugs or issues, you can let us know there as well. See you next time with more update news!

notes.title: Travellers Rest Tribune 4
notes.content:

Greetings, Tavernkeeps!

To say that the response to Travellers Rest has been overwhelming would be an understatement. We are humbled and grateful for the incredible outpouring of love for the game and the amazing reviews (98% positive!!), comments, and feedback we’ve received. 

We’ve been very busy keeping up with bug reports, and Louqou has already started tackling some of the things we’ve seen reported. While we do not have a set patch schedule that we’ll be sticking to, the following issues will be corrected in our first patch planned for tomorrow: 

[list]

We’ve heard players asking for more information about the roadmap, and while we don’t have an exact date to share with you, it is coming, and we hope to be sharing the first glimpse of that with you in a couple of weeks. We will be opting to share a quarterly version of the roadmap rather than a more extensive one, which will allow us to be more accurate, and to best reflect what’s currently being worked on. 

We are so excited for the future of Travellers Rest, and we’ll be sharing more news in next week’s Travellers Tribune. See you then!

notes.title: Welcome to Travellers Rest Early Access!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/c968167911e5828e7b2470518e2b394c444a1818.gif[/img]

Greetings, Tavernkeeps, 

We are so excited to welcome you to the Early Access release of Travellers Rest! We want to say a heartfelt thanks to our community for helping us reach this milestone, and for supporting our game every step of the way. From testing, to translations, to just playing the demo and offering your feedback, your help has been invaluable in getting the game ready for today. 

Over the last several months, Louqou has worked tirelessly to add new features and content, and to squash as many bugs as our testers could find.  These are just some of the changes and additions: 

[list]
[*] Renting rooms - decorate and rent rooms to weary travellers.
[*] Kitty! You now have a pet cat, along with a water bowl, bed, and a relationship system.
[*] Trends - Fluctuating item trends. Stocking trending items will reward you with more reputation and money!
[*] Magic broom - Sick of mopping up after your customers? This enchanted broom will keep your floors clean.
[*] Localisation - Including French, Spanish, German, Polish, Chinese, Portuguese, Turkish, Japanese, and Korean.
[*] Sprint meter - increase your stamina by upgrading your Bartending skill!
[*] Earn more reputation and money by stocking unique items.
[*] Don’t stay up too late - you will now sleep-in after passing out.
[*] Crafting yield - Increasing your Crafting skill to increase the amount of items you get from crafting.
[*] Hovering over beer taps displays a tooltip that displays the current keg.
[*] A link to our discord and now be found on the pause menu.
[/list]

Over the coming days and weeks, we’ll be releasing our Early Access roadmap so that the community can catch a glimpse of what will be coming to Travellers Rest. There is a lot planned, and we’ll be listening eagerly to the community’s feedback and suggestions as we work toward the final release of the game. If you’re the creative type, you can even [url=https://discord.gg/PVs8Csx]drop by on Discord[/url] and toss in your text lines for the townspeople. We’ve had so many great submissions already, and we look forward to adding them into the game over time. 

Our immediate priority following today’s release will of course be fixing bugs and issues that arise now that the game is out “in the wild.” If you encounter any, please let us know on our [url=https://discord.gg/9d8y68T]Discord bug reports channel.[/url] Our Early Access journey is just the beginning for the game, and we look forward to building the game alongside you!

notes.title: Travellers Rest releases on the 28th of July, in 2 days! Demo Removal also!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello there fellow Travellers![/h1]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/5926baa23697c781b33e10d04fb4e371bd4c7e80.png[/img]

We just wanted to take the opportunity to thank each and every one of you who has wishlisted the game, played the demo or participated in localization and beta testing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/64e814f6b493a3bb3120b886a37042c5bc525ee1.png[/img]

So much has changed in the past few months that the current Demo is now out of date to the point of it not being representative of the Early Access product that we will be launching on Tuesday 28th of July at 6 pm CEST. As such, starting this afternoon we will be removing the Demo link entirely. We initially had only made the demo for the Steam Summer Festival, but due to popular demand kept it available until now. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/c6b6f306deea1c48ab9fe527765de88a34efad0d.png[/img]

We've all been working hard in preparation for early-access. We look forward to hearing your responses and hope you have fun with the game! Your feedback helps make the game better!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662206/6d1888d46dae6dcb7ca374028b4c7f0ce24fa025.png[/img]

On a side note, over 25 thousand people have wishlisted the game in a little under two months, which we feel is amazing and humbling. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts!

Once again, thank you so much!

The Travellers Rest team
